question: Which due diligence questionnaire in the corpus asks the manager 'What kills a deal for your team?', and who published it?
expected_facts: The Private Markets Due Diligence Questionnaire ('Your Resource for Evaluating Private Market Partners') published by Calamos Investments with Aksia (file AC_Private_Markets). The question appears under General Questions > Investment Strategy and asks the manager to describe a recent example.
acceptance: AC Private Markets / Calamos with Aksia accepted. Subtitle, copyright year and recent-example follow-up are optional.
